name: Home basics: move-in date + restore the mover rows
hostSurface: Per-home settings: web /app/homes/[id]/settings (editor at /edit:320); iOS HomeSettingsViewModel; Android HomeSettingsScreen.
purpose: Make the gate for the whole mover experience editable, and give a synced dismissal a way back.
contents: Two rows in Home Info: 'Moved in' with a date control (PATCH /api/homes/:id { move_in_date }) and a helper line saying what it drives ('Shows your first-week steps for 60 days'); and 'Moving checklist — Show again', visible only while dismissed.
states: future date or >60 days ago (warn the rows will not appear)
entryPoints: Place file 'Moved in' row (tap to set)
Undo toast after dismissing the mover rows
visualization: Two plain settings rows; the only decision is the native date control and the helper line, without which 'Move-in date' reads as trivia rather than the switch that turns the mover experience on.
uxNote: Highest-leverage half-day in F6: both natives can only ever stamp move_in_date = today from an add-home checkbox and have no correction path, so a mover who claims their address three weeks after moving gets a window three weeks wrong and anyone who missed the checkbox never sees the rows at all — F6's acceptance criteria are literally unreachable on iOS and Android today.
